name: e2e-cli-workflow
description: End-to-end CLI workflow scenarios: simulate real user configuration, daemon boot, VFS operations, plugin/command queries, error handling, and lifecycle management.

steps.description: User boots the daemon with default config and explores the system through CLI.
flow: status → JSON: started=true, state='active', mounts contains / and /workspace, plugins contains core.runtime
vfs read /status.json → valid JSON with ok:true
steps.expect: All CLI commands return correct structured output; daemon is fully operational after single boot command.

steps.description: User queries file and directory metadata through vfs stat.
steps.expect: stat returns correct path, name, and type for both files and mount-point directories. name is derived from VFS global path, not adapter-local root.

steps.description: User requests watch/stream resource handles on VFS paths.
flow: vfs watch /status.json → JSON with kind='watch', path='/status.json', released after release()
vfs stream /status.json → JSON with kind='stream', path='/status.json'
steps.expect: Both handle types return structured metadata; release semantics are correct.

steps.description: User inspects registered plugins and contributed commands.
flow: plugin show core.runtime → manifest with name and version
command list → array containing core.runtime.status with description
steps.expect: Plugin introspection returns accurate manifest data; command contributions are discoverable.

steps.description: User enters invalid commands or accesses non-existent paths.
flow: vfs delete /file → throws 'Unknown command' (no such CLI verb)
steps.expect: CLI surfaces clear, typed errors for unknown commands and VFS not-found. No silent failures or undefined behavior.

steps.description: User configures multiple plugins, each contributing mount points and commands.
flow: status → all 3 plugins listed, /skills and /prompts in mounts
command list → includes skills.list and prompts.list
steps.expect: Multiple plugins can register independent mount points; all contributed files, directories, and commands are accessible through standard CLI.

steps.description: User starts, operates, stops, and restarts the daemon.
steps.expect: State is fully cleaned on stop and fully restored on restart. No leaked mounts or stale data across cycles.

steps.description: User accidentally starts the daemon twice.
steps.expect: Double start is idempotent. No exception, no duplicate mounts, daemon remains operational.

steps.description: A faulty plugin throws during setup; user expects clean rollback.
steps.expect: Plugin setup failure prevents daemon from entering started state. All previously registered mounts and plugins are rolled back. Core.runtime dispose is called.

steps.description: Downstream consumer subscribes to VFS events through daemon kernel.
steps.expect: Event bus is accessible on the daemon's kernel. Read-only operations do not emit events. Subscription lifecycle is clean.
